facts.business: Oxygenta Pharmaceutical Limited is a pharmaceutical company engaged in commercial sales transactions, with significant revenue from its holding company Virupaksha Organics Limited.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to continuous net losses, negative net worth of Rs. (4,268.68) lakhs, working capital deficit of Rs. (3,181.73) lakhs, and increased borrowings to Rs. 10,900+ lakhs; Key audit matters include ECL on trade receivables (Rs. 1,179.64 lakhs gross with Rs. 130.09 lakhs provision), deferred tax asset recoverability, and significant related party transactions with holding company Virupaksha Organics Limited (56.5% stake acquired, loans increased 176% to Rs. 5,211.14 lakhs)

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to continuous net losses and complete erosion of net worth
Significant related party transactions with holding company Virupaksha Organics Limited
High expected credit loss on trade receivables including amounts due from holding company
Deferred tax asset recoverability dependent on future profitability under revised strategic plan
Working capital deficit of Rs. (3,181.73) lakhs
Increased borrowings primarily from holding company
facts.related_party_note: During FY 2025-26, Virupaksha Organics Limited acquired 56.5% equity stake becoming holding company. Related party transactions include: (a) Loans received from holding company - non-current borrowings increased 176% from Rs. 1,189.42 lakhs to Rs. 5,211.14 lakhs; (b) Commercial sales to holding company forming significant portion of total revenue of Rs. 11,298.19 lakhs; (c) Trade receivable balances outstanding from holding company as at 31 March 2026. All transactions reviewed for arm's length pricing and approved by audit committee/shareholders per SEBI LODR Regulation 23.
